title: Ultraformer MPT vs Ultraformer III
h1: Ultraformer MPT vs Ultraformer III: what's different and which to choose
desc: Ultraformer MPT vs Ultraformer III HIFU compared: technology, comfort, speed, results and prices in Dubai at Skin & Laser.
answer: Both are HIFU devices that lift and tighten with focused ultrasound. Ultraformer MPT is the newer generation, delivering energy in micro-pulses for more comfort and faster sessions; Ultraformer III is the established version and costs less. At Skin & Laser, MPT is AED 7,000 + VAT for the face and Ultraformer III is AED 5,000 + VAT.
facts: MPT AED 7,000 + VAT; III AED 5,000 + VAT
MPT AED 14,000 + VAT; III AED 7,000 + VAT
body:
## How they differ

Ultraformer III fires single focused shots at fixed depths. MPT breaks energy into rapid micro-pulses spread across the area, which keeps heat gentler and lets the practitioner work faster.

## Which to choose

- Sensitive to discomfort or wanting the latest technology: MPT
- Budget-conscious or a body area: Ultraformer III
- Either: early jowls, jawline and neck laxity
faq: Both lift well; MPT mainly improves comfort and speed.
Results are similar, typically around a year.
Yes, your doctor can choose either for top-ups.
